page.layout: One blank page with library stamps only: a blue oval stamp at the upper right, a red crowned stamp at the lower left, and a digitiser's credit at the bottom right.
page.notes: No printed text. The blue and red stamps (one reading "Biblioteca" and one with "Neapolis" around a royal emblem) are library stamps and are not transcribed. The faint marks at the bottom right are the digitiser's credit, also not transcribed. The page shows stains and show-through only.
